system.description:
A replacement arm and hand; like all bionic limbs it gives +2 AP against hits to that location. Common arms match the original in strength, dexterity and touch.

Poor: Dexterity is halved for fine work, and Weaponry and Ballistics Tests with the arm take -2k0. Good: +1k0 on Dexterity Tests that need delicate handling, Sleight of Hand for example, plus +1k0 on Strength Tests with that arm. Best adds no further benefit beyond Good.
system.effectText: Poor: halves Dex for fine work, -2k0 Weaponry/Ballistics with it. Good: +1k0 delicate Dex tests and +1k0 Strength with that arm.
